messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: No variance estimates for lambda0 in null model
parts:
Joe
When I run your constant-parameter model I get healthy estimates (below). I used a non-spatial fit as a starting point, but I can't see that would have changed much. I predict that you will get OK variances with method = 'none'. I did see some strange behavior during optimisation: it periodically tryied parameters that jumped the likelihood down to about -7171 from -7140. That may have made Newton-Raphson unstable (a case for Nelder-Mead?).
Murray
